text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":7,"why":"Utterance 7 states 'Um, so my skin's quite red, um, and I'm using coconut butter for the past few days.' which implies dry and itchy skin on arms and hands."},{"i":1,"v":"INFERRED","u":9,"why":"The doctor infers this from the patient's description of dry and itchy skin on arms and hands."},{"i":2,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":39,"why":"Utterance 39 states 'No.' to the doctor's question about fevers and vomiting."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":26,"why":"Utterance 26 states 'Um, I work as a teacher.'."},{"i":4,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":44,"why":"Utterance 44 asks 'Are you eating and drinking OK?' and patient responds 'Yeah, I've been drinking, and eating as normal.'."},{"i":5,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":43,"why":"Utterance 43 states 'Uh, yeah, I think I have been, quite tired.'."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":36,"why":"Utterance 36 states 'No.' to the doctor's question about vomiting."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":63,"why":"Utterance 63 states 'Uh, no, I don't take any other medications.'."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":54,"why":"Utterance 54 states 'In terms of your medical history, there's no, problems of skin problems in the past, things like eczema or, um, dermatitis?' and patient responds 'Uh, no, I think it might just be the weather.'."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":75,"why":"Utterance 75 states 'I think, um, I might be lactose intolerant.'."},{"i":10,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":77,"why":"Utterance 77 states 'Um, yeah, so um, my dad has asthma, and, my mum has hayfever.'."}]}
